title: UNE & DAUL (으네 & 다울) | Full Episode | Sound K
description:
Sound K의 가족이기도 했던 으네가 다울과 함께 앨범을 냈는데요!
그 동안 어떻게 지냈는지 근황 이야기부터
만화 '오즈의 마법사'에서 아이디어를 얻어 만든 앨범 [OZLand]에 관한 이야기까지
많은 이야기와 듣기 좋은 목소리로 들려준 완벽한 라이브까지 함께 들어보세요!

UNE, who was also a member of Sound K's family, released an album with DAUL!
From the recent story of how you've been, to the story of the album [OZLand], which was inspired by the movie 'The Wizard of Oz'!
Listen to a lot of stories and even the perfect live that was told with a nice voice!
